name: Datashaper Radiant Dragon
text:
2+ Cyberse Effect Monsters
This card in the Extra Monster Zone is unaffected by other monster effects. When this card is Link Summoned it gains 300 ATK for each Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xys Monster in your GY. When this card declares an attack your opponent cannot activate nay cards or effects. If this card is sent to the GY; You can Special Summon 1 Cyberse Monster from your Deck or Extra Deck.
